lines.t: Thus says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand the power, the birth
In my left hand judgment and flame
I am he, the ancient of days
The great I am, the God of Abraham
Isaac and Jacob, whose name is Israel
Every knee will bow. Every nation will cower. The Holy One returns. The trumpet sounds. The Lord of Hosts is heaven bound.
Make the way straight. Prepare His path. Don't wait. Yahushua, have my seers. The lion will roar. Call His name. Be restored.
Ahead came John the voice in the wild
Crying out repent the spirit compiled
Trumpet in hand water and word
Baptized the broken spoke what he heard
Fire in their voices trumpet in hand
Spirit of Elijah thunder in their breath
Death witnesses walking with tongues aflame, bearing his name, not seeking fame.
Judgments fall, foundations quake, the pride of man, the Lord shall break.
Cities fall, towers bend, desolation sweeps, there's hope in the end.
Call upon Yahushua, call and be saved, the Lamb who conquered the grave.
Yet there's sanctuary in the storm, a way of escape has been formed.
He is the Christ, Yahushua by name, call upon him.
The Lion, the Lion, the Lord
All is made, here is more
Read the lips, the Lord comes nigh
Fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight
And you shall surely be delivered
